scope: Ridge alpha sweep for the EPIC Ego repair router
summary: Alpha values 0.001, 0.1, and 1.0 reproduced the same 1/6 selection accuracy and 0.0479 mean regret, showing the failure is objective/data structure rather than ridge regularization.
evidence: Independent experiment manifests 20260811T070254Z-3d2b3750, 20260811T070254Z-5fc1b810, and 20260811T070255Z-0725a05c all retain status rejected.
Every sweep point has 0.1667 selection accuracy, 0.047879 mean regret, and 1.0 non-regression rate.
lessons: Hyperparameter search must stop when multiple orders of magnitude produce identical held-action behavior; the objective and feasible candidate set need inspection.
limitations: The sweep does not add scenes, actions, seeds, or independent supervision.
next_actions: Audit candidate feasibility against the strict background gate and keep the learned checkpoint off the delivery route if no candidate satisfies both background and non-regression constraints.
